Multiply imputed design-based SEM

Source: R/mi.R, R/pooled.R
svysem_mi-class.Rd

Fits of one model to each completed survey design, pooled afterwards with Rubin's rules. The design degrees of freedom are the complete-data degrees of freedom (df.com) unless the user overrides them in pooled_estimates() or pooled_wald().

Usage

# S4 method for class 'svysem_mi'
show(object)

# S3 method for class 'svysem_mi'
coef(object, ...)

# S4 method for class 'svysem_mi'
coef(object, ...)

# S3 method for class 'svysem_mi'
vcov(object, ...)

# S4 method for class 'svysem_mi'
vcov(object, ...)

# S3 method for class 'svysem_mi'
nobs(object, ...)

# S3 method for class 'svysem_mi'
summary(object, ...)

# S3 method for class 'svysem_mi.summary'
print(x, ...)

# S4 method for class 'svysem_mi'
fitMeasures(
  object,
  fit.measures = "all",
  baseline.model = NULL,
  h1.model = NULL,
  fm.args = list(standard.test = "default", scaled.test = "default", rmsea.ci.level =
    0.9, rmsea.close.h0 = 0.05, rmsea.notclose.h0 = 0.08, robust = TRUE, cat.check.pd =
    TRUE),
  output = "vector",
  ...
)

Arguments

object

A svysem_mi object.

...

Further arguments, ignored.

x

A summary of a svysem_mi object.

fit.measures

"all" or a character vector of measure names to keep.

baseline.model

Accepted for compatibility with lavaan's generic. Not used: each imputation already carries its own baseline.

h1.model

Accepted for compatibility with lavaan's generic. Not used.

fm.args

Passed to lavaan::fitMeasures() on each imputation.

output

"vector" (default), or "matrix" / "data.frame" for a one-row data frame.

Value

An object of class svysem_mi. coef() returns the pooled point estimates, vcov() their total covariance, and summary() an object of class svysem_mi.summary.

Details

The object is returned by svysem(), svycfa() or svygrowth() when design is a svyimputationList. Each completed design is fitted separately. on_fail = "stop" stops at the first imputation that errors. on_fail = "omit" records that imputation in status and pools the rest, provided at least two fits remain. coef() and vcov() are the Rubin pooled estimate and its total covariance. Both are S4 methods, so they still dispatch after lavaan has turned those generics into S4 methods.

Slots

fits

Successful fits, in imputation order, with failures removed.

df

Design degrees of freedom, survey::degf() of the completed designs. This is the default df.com when pooling.

nobs_used

Number of rows with a positive sampling weight in the first completed design.

status

One row per imputation, including failures. Columns are no.conv, no.se, no.npd and message (an empty string when the imputation did not error).

estimator

Estimator name. "MLM", "WLSMV", or "MLR".

svysem_call

The call that created the object.

References

Rubin D (1987). Multiple Imputation for Nonresponse in Surveys. Wiley, New York. doi:10.1002/9780470316696

Barnard J, Rubin DB (1999). "Small-Sample Degrees of Freedom with Multiple Imputation." Biometrika, 86(4), 948–959. doi:10.1093/biomet/86.4.948

See also

pooled_estimates(), pooled_wald(), survey::svydesign()

Examples

if (requireNamespace("mitools", quietly = TRUE)) {
  base <- simulate_design(
    n_psu = 6, n_per = 4, n_strata = 2, seed = 1
  )$variables
  alt <- base
  alt$y <- alt$y + 0.2
  des <- survey::svydesign(
    ids = ~psu, strata = ~strat, weights = ~w,
    data = mitools::imputationList(list(base, alt))
  )
  fit <- svysem(
    "y ~ x1 + x2", des,
    fixed.x = FALSE, meanstructure = TRUE
  )
  coef(fit)
  fit
}
#> svysem_mi (multiple imputation)
#> Estimator: MLM
#> Imputations: 2 used / 2 supplied
#> Design degrees of freedom: 10
#> Observations: 48
#> Not converged: 0; no SE: 0; not positive definite: 0
